# vendor

Place the QNX Software Center Linux installer here as `qnx-setup-linux.run`.

Download it from the QNX Software Center page (Linux x86_64 build, version 2.0.4
or later, which SDP 8.0 baselines require), then:

```
cp ~/Downloads/qnx-setup-*-linux.run vendor/qnx-setup-linux.run
```

The `.run` is gitignored; it is yours to download under your own QNX license and
is not committed.
